d: The phrase "Asian wives of American tech elites under scanner" stems from a wave of viral social media commentary and news coverage—such as a recent WION Gravitas report—following the November 2026 espionage and infidelity scandal involving Nvidia co-founder Jensen Huang. While the scandal centers on an alleged affair with a suspected Chinese intelligence operative, online commentators have broadened the scrutiny into baseless conspiracy theories targeting the Asian spouses of other prominent American tech and media executives.
